description:
Right cerebellar hemisphere intra-axial mass showing heterogenous signal intensity on T2WI, restricted diffusion and heterogeneous enhancement on post-contrast T1WI.

Associated vasogenic edema.

Mass effect displaces pons anteriorly effacing the prepontine cistern and the cerebellar tonsils inferiorly through the foramen magnum.
